verdict.rationale: An official Raygun MCP server exists (MindscapeHQ/mcp-server-raygun), and Raygun captures full stack traces, ranks errors by users affected and occurrences, and offers a status workflow for triage. That gives an agent a first-party path to production error data, but the pack never says what the MCP server exposes. Separately, the external access token is documented only for deployment and symbol/source-map uploads, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documentation of MCP/API tools that retrieve top issues with stack traces, programmatic triage (status changes) via API/MCP, any issue-tracker integration for filing bugs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
